column1: # X9 E2 measurement (a): every ChannelDeclaration::judging()-declaring class,
# with its current dogfooded coupling.cbo value and whether its JudgedMetrics/
# MetricName import is used ONLY inside the method holding the judging() call
# (declaration-only) or also elsewhere in the class body.
# Obtained by (same-reader rule): a nikic/php-parser AST walk
# (scratchpad/e2-enumerate.php), NOT grep/token text matching. For every PHP
# file under src/, parsed with NameResolver + ParentConnectingVisitor, finds
# every static call ChannelDeclaration::judging(...), resolves the enclosing
# class and the enclosing method (the "declaring method" -- always
# channelDeclarations() for every hit found, never hardcoded as that name),
# then for JudgedMetrics and MetricName separately collects every resolved Name
# node in the whole class and classifies each as inside or outside that method.
# coupling.cbo values are the project's own measurement:
# bin/qmx check src/ --format=metrics --workers=0 (raw metrics dump, not a
# findings report, so classes below threshold are visible too), matched by FQCN.
# What this does not see: an import resolved to a class of the same short name
# in a different namespace would be misattributed by the AST reader if such a
# name existed unimported in the same file (none does here -- verified by the
# import list carried in the raw enumerator output, not reproduced in this table).
# A class using judging() through a helper/wrapper method other than
# channelDeclarations() itself would still be found by the StaticCall search,
# but is not exercised anywhere in this tree (all 20 hits are literally in a
# method named channelDeclarations).
# Population: 20 producer files declaring judging() (covering 22 concrete rules
# -- AbstractTypeCoverageRule is one shared abstract base for
# ParamTypeCoverageRule/PropertyTypeCoverageRule/ReturnTypeCoverageRule, so 3
# concrete rules share one CBO-paying file). ClassRankRule was confirmed by this
# same AST reader NOT to call judging() (it calls occurrence()) -- the reader
# checks the mechanism, not the rule's own docblock claim.
# Headline result: JudgedMetrics is declaration-only in all 20/20 files --
# every single import exists solely to spell the judging() call. MetricName is
# declaration-only in 0/19 files that import it at all (AbstractTypeCoverageRule
# does not import MetricName -- its subclasses supply the metric key via
# coverageMetric(), so the base class never names MetricName directly); every
# other file already reads MetricName elsewhere in its body (metric lookups),
# so removing the declaration-only credit would not remove that import.
